text:
mike: heads up — RFC followup: seed bootstrap deps cause disk blowout on customer sandbox clusters, hitting 90%+ /var/lib/modelstore during delta replay.

sara: seen that. which step is using most space? unpack? temp staging?

mike: unpack + dedupe pass. operator downloads full seed tar, then parallel unpackers create short-lived copies. Example: `tar -xzf seed-2026.tar.gz -C /var/lib/modelstore && cp -r ...`

lee: short-term mitigation: stream-extract to final path, avoid intermediate cp. we could change operator to `tar -xzf -C` and use atomic mv instead of cp.

jordan: question: operator needs repo-level index to compute deltas. can we offload index compute to a sidecar so operator never holds both old+new at same time?

sara: sidecar idea sounds good but increases memory and a new API. Also offline airgap: customers can't run sidecars that call out. need local-only mode.

mike: agreed. tradeoff: sidecar is optional when operator has enough quota. fallback: stream-apply algorithm that patches files in place using chunk diffs.

lee: stream-apply has complexity with rewrite-atomicity. if powercut halfway we need tombstones and activation fencing. Risk: partial files + k8s restarts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `staging/seed-apply-stream` to 3 clusters — rollout id 2026-03-seed-3

jordan: operational ask — we should surface storage estimates pre-download in Console. show `estimated_peak_gb` based on manifest and apply strategy.

mike: prototype manifest field: `peak_estimate_gb: 12.4` and `apply_mode: stream|staged` — Console can sum these per-route before starting.

sara: what about dedupe/packed layers? if manifest lists packed blobs we decompress into fs, peak is lower. need clear contract between packer and manifest.

lee: suggestion: add `max_temp_factor` to operator config (e.g., 1.2) to cap staging usage and fail early with actionable error rather than OOM.

jordan: can we also add quota-driven graceful fallback: if quota insufficient, operator tries `small-batch-apply` slower but lower peak.

mike: timeline: I'll spin up a mini RFC doc with heuristics + API for manifest fields. want feedback on metrics to collect: actual_peak, fail_reason, time_to_apply.

sara: +1. please include a small onprem checklist: `kube-pv-size`, `operator-temp-dir`, `sidecar-enabled` flags. customers always ask what to size.

lee: FYI: we have a customer that hit this in prod last month; I'll DM logs to mike.

mike: thanks. @jordan @sara I'll draft RFC by EOD. If folks want to test the canary, it's live — `kubectl rollout status deployment/seed-apply-stream -n redwood-staging`
